payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Change the black DVD in the source image to a white DVD, preserving it as the same DVD object and its recognizable disc form and center hole.
outcome.target: The original black DVD is white across its disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD; do not count a newly added white disc or a white object elsewhere as fulfillment.
outcome.reference: The black DVD visible near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right.

check.question: Has the original black DVD been transformed into a white DVD?
check.complete_when: The same DVD at the source location has a visibly white disc surface, retaining its recognizable DVD shape and center hole.
check.partial_when: The original DVD is identifiable and some of its disc surface has been changed toward white, but it is not fully white.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains black with no visible progress toward white, is missing or unchanged, or only a separate white disc/object has been added while the original remains untransformed.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be confidently identified or its color and transformation cannot be assessed from the available images.

The original DVD has not visibly been transformed."}
